event_summary: A small blue round object moves from the left across a wooden tabletop, passes beyond the table edge near a white sheet, and exits to the right.
raw_event_description: The video opens on a stationary view of a wooden tabletop beside a light wall and a pale rectangular sheet or panel on the right. After a period with no moving object visible, a small blue round object enters from the left on the tabletop. It travels rightward across the tabletop, reaches the right edge near the pale sheet, then is seen to the right of the tabletop in front of the wall/sheet area. It continues rightward and leaves the frame. The scene remains otherwise unchanged.

reasons: The tabletop, wall, and pale sheet are visible at the start.
The blue moving object is not yet visible in the first frame.
